CC7.4.4 Data center facility incidents and corrective measures are reported monthly for management review.
Inspected the data center facility incident reports for a sample of IBX data centers and months during the period to determine that  reports addressing data center facility incidents and corrective measures were reported for management review for each IBX data center and month sampled.
The test of the control activity disclosed that reports addressing data center facility incidents and corrective measures were not reported at three of 62 IBX data centers sampled for three of three months sampled.
Management’s Response:
The exception raised is applicable to the AMER LM1, ST1, and ST3 IBX data centers.  The LM1, ST1, and ST3 IBXs were acquired by Equinix in 2022 and all processes at these data centers had not fully integrated into Equinix at time of audit testing.  The IBXs have since been integrated to Equinix and data center incident reporting has been implemented in line with Equinix process.  There were no impacts to IBX operations identified by management due to the exception.
